relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: A major mechanism through which capsaicin relieves pain is through activating TRPV1 channels, which induce calcium influx and neurotransmitter release.

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: A condition such as arthritis or neuropathy can be relieved with capsaicin as it depletes substance P from nerves.

key_findings: Review of capsaicin pain applications: TRPV1 activation, substance P depletion and nerve ending desensitization.
Nanotechnology and capsaicin-mimetics may reduce pungency and improve therapeutic index.
